The '''B25-SAL Probe Droid''' was a model of floating cube-shaped [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS" />
